title: US Stamps "Juliette Low" Founder Of The Girl Scouts 3¢ First Day Of Issue - Used
descriptionText: The product is a US postage stamp featuring Juliette Low, the founder of the Girl Scouts, issued on the first day of its release. This 3-cent stamp, in green color, originates from the United States and is in VF/XF grade. The cancellation type indicates its being used on the first day of issue, making it a special collectible item for stamp enthusiasts interested in Girl Scouts and Girl Guides memorabilia.
